correctness.rationale: The fixed-pair language is factorial. Exact prefix enumeration gives a single length-58 survivor and no length-59 survivor. A second implementation rescans every candidate for all reducedness, forbidden-pair, and square constraints and produces identical level sets. Direct factor inspection shows the unique extremizer misses only 10. The eight inversion-preserving alphabet permutations are explicitly generated and verified to act transitively on the eight possible length-two Dean factors, yielding exactly eight distinct global extremizers.

value.rationale: The length-58 class is the sharp equality boundary immediately below the published theorem that every length-59 Dean word contains all possible length-two factors. Classifying that boundary exactly identifies the unique obstruction for each missing pair and shows that the eight alphabet-symmetry images exhaust all failures at the sharp threshold. This is a natural complete equality classification, not an arbitrary finite census.
